subject: Re: Kickoff: KnowNo-style uncertainty alignment for agent workflows
body:
Priya,

Staffing and infra:

- Vera Egede is allocated at 60% to this project for May 2026 — she owns the calibration-set construction and the conformal threshold tuning, and I've locked that in the staffing plan. April she's at 40% while she closes out a previous commitment.
- Rosa 40% on the shadow-mode integration with the production agent workflow.
- Wanjiru 30% on logging/telemetry — help-rate and completion-rate need clean instrumentation or the Jul 8 curves are fiction.
- Farah 25% on the option-generation prompt harness.

Compute/serving: inference-only, so no cluster reservations. We do need a dedicated eval quota on the internal LLM endpoint — calibration involves scoring full option sets per task, and I don't want us rate-limited mid-run. I'll size the ask once Vera counts tasks; ballpark 200k scored options for a 1,000-task calibration set.

One dependency: shadow mode needs sign-off from the workflow's owning team; Rosa is setting that up this week.

Ivo
